$comment: Params for projectile_sim, owned by the vetted renderer (VSL-08, VSL-30). Starting values within the declared ranges; readouts at the starting values are computed by phys_projectile (VER-17) and the client model is cross-checked against it (VSL-31). An angled launch states its angle in degrees above the horizontal. An optional `predict` names a predict, observe, explain scenario (VSL-47). Free-form drawing fields (svg, path, html, points_raw) are not allowed (VSL-01).
title: projectile_sim params

angle.$comment: Degrees above the horizontal, for an angled launch.

predict.$comment: A predict, observe, explain scenario of this kind (VSL-47, packages/renderers/src/sims/scenarios.json): the student predicts before the simulation runs; the scenario's starting values replace the request's own.
